purpose: Say that a limited action is enough to settle a matter.
keywords: Verb て-form + 済む; negative なくて / ないで / ずに + 済む
This is not a problem that an apology will settle.
It was enough to replace the part.
The rain stopped, so I did not need to buy an umbrella.
formation: Verb て-form + 済む; negative なくて / ないで / ずに + 済む
restrictions: Often expresses relief that a larger cost or action was unnecessary.
mistake: Use なくて済む for not needing to do something; て済む describes what suffices.
